report.summary: Knorr-Bremse AG is a Munich-based global manufacturer of braking systems and rail vehicle components. The company presents a mixed risk profile: it has a resolved 2018 U.S. Department of Justice antitrust settlement and ongoing safety recalls involving Knorr-Bremse brake chambers, but also demonstrates strong financial guidance for 2026 and high ESG ratings. Key concerns for a buyer include product safety defects and operational transition risks from recent restructuring and divestitures. Procurement should prioritize verifying current product quality certifications and the stability of supply chains affected by the rail division spin-off and HVAC divestiture.

Knorr-Bremse concluded an agreement to sell its global HVAC business unit (Merak) to OpenGate Capital on July 28, 2026.
Knorr-Bremse improved its 2025 CDP Climate Change score from 'A-' to 'A', earning a place on the CDP A-List.
Knorr-Bremse expects revenues between €8,000 million and €8,300 million and an operating EBIT margin of around 14% for the 2026 fiscal year.
